title: Splash screen spinner should fade out instead of pause when fading into desktop
line: The splash screen's spinner now fades out smoothly instead of freezing while the splash fades into the desktop.
explanation: ksplashqml called exit() the moment it reached its last stage (or when org.kde.PlasmaLoading went away), so the window was destroyed with the spinner still on screen and KWin's login effect faded out that frozen last frame. Breeze tried to fade the spinner at stage 5, but it reused the intro animator, which is still running at that point now that stages come from a 200 ms timer, so the fade never happened. Now ksplash sets stage 6 on the windows and quits 200 ms later (both on the timer and when Plasma finishes loading), and Breeze fades the spinner out on stage 6 with its own animator.

commits.message:
ksplash: let the theme fade out before quitting

The splash quit as soon as its last stage was reached, so the busy
indicator froze in place while the closing window faded out. Now ksplash
waits a moment after the last stage, and Breeze fades the indicator out.

BUG: 368942

media.caption: Master, frame by frame (30 fps, spinner area): the spinner stays fully visible while the splash fades into the desktop.
Patched, same frames: the spinner fades out first, then the splash fades into the desktop without it.
